data.design: Original Lapras proportions and poses. Cold white and cream body, muted grey shell, jade eye, faded-yellow forehead scar. Small pixel accents and sparse stepped mist behind the body. No elaborate aura or claim that Ghost typing implies malice. The scar’s meaning is undecided.

moves.description: Level 5 in the species learnset. Inherited sleep move; a possible source for performance direction, not proof of a new lore power.
moves.name: Sing

questions.question: Which Ghost techniques, if any, should distinguish this form from its inherited Lapras moves, and when should they become available?

description:
A recognizable Lapras made cold-white and ghostly. The Water/Ghost form must be capable of tenderness as well as unease; the specific pier individual carries the planned relationship arc.

The current regional form changes typing to Water/Ghost while inheriting ordinary Lapras’s level-up moves and abilities: Water Absorb, Shell Armor and hidden Hydration. The inherited level-up list has Confuse Ray but no damaging Ghost-type attacks. Its eventual recruitment, growth and regional move identity therefore remain real design work.
